title: Run a program with a specific environment variable
summary: Execute a command with one or more environment variables set temporarily. This is often used to change settings like locale or proxy for a single command.

steps.explain: Use env to set a variable=value pair before the program name. The variable is only active for this specific command execution.

placeholders.name: VARIABLE
placeholders.description: The name of the environment variable to set

placeholders.name: VALUE
placeholders.description: The value to assign to the variable

placeholders.name: PROGRAM
placeholders.description: The command or program to run
